about_the_game:
Virtuoso GP Race-On doesn’t copy or “dress up” the retro: it’s a new arcade racer
with bespoke physics and handling that recreates the feel of 90s polygonal greats.
It isn’t emulation or a fancy filter: gameplay comes first.

WHY YOU’LL GET HOOKED
- True 90s handling: precision, inertia and tuned drifts — not a “retro look” with modern-feel controls.
- EXTEND TIME: hit checkpoints, gain seconds; miss one and it’s Game Over. Pure arcade.
- Instant loop: restart instantly, with ghosts & split times… “one more run”.
- Global leaderboards: fight for thousandths and share your best laps.

GAME MODES
- Arcade: 3 chained routes in classic style, time pressure and route choices.
- Season: a full championship across the 9 tracks.
- Career: upgrade your car step by step and beat new rivals in progression.
- Minigames: skill challenges to master drift, line and rhythm.

CONTENT
- 9 tracks with their reverse versions, across 3 regions (Americas, Eurasia, Africa/Oceania).
- 3 vehicle classes and unlockable cars.
- Global record table with ghosts and split times.

VISUAL STYLE
- Low-poly with dithering and reduced color palettes for an authentic 90s grain.
- Simulated 4:3 → 16:9 stretching (as on period monitors).
- “Aged” art and clean UI for instant readability.

TRY IT: FREE DEMO
- 2 tracks: Sakura Coast and Dunas de Giza.
- 1 single-seater tuned to slide sideways.
- Works with keyboard and gamepad.
- Instant restart to practice and set times.

WHO IS IT FOR?
For players who lived —or seek today— true arcade racing: tight control,
time pressure and the satisfaction of nailing the perfect lap.

JOIN THE PIT CREW
Add it to your wishlist and play the demo. Ready… GO!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2,0 GHz (Intel i3-2100 / AMD A6)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / GeForce GT 710 (1 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core 3,0 GHz (Intel i5-4430 / Ryzen 3 1200)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 Ti / Radeon R7 260X (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
